translation:
<ins>Restorative Blood-Moving Decoction (復元活血湯)</ins>
Bupleurum (柴胡, five qian), dang gui (當歸), pangolin (穿山甲, parched), trichosanthes root (栝蔞根, each three qian), licorice (甘草), safflower (紅花, each two qian), peach kernel (桃仁, skin and tip removed, fifty), rhubarb (大黃, soaked in wine, one liang)
Above, grind the peach kernel into a paste; cut the remaining medicines into pieces the size of hemp and bean; take one liang per dose. With two cups of water and half a cup of wine, decoct to seven-tenths, remove the dregs, take greatly warm before food, stopping when there is a bowel movement. <ins>Bajie Decoction (巴戟湯)</ins>
Morinda (巴戟, core removed), rhubarb (大黃, each half liang), dang gui (當歸), rehmannia (地黃), peony (芍藥), chuanxiong (川芎, each one liang)
Above, grind into powder, decoct in water and take, stopping when there is a bowel movement.
